description: Chain vectors. issuers, policy and the verify_root rules are as in task_root.json (same keys and policy). For each vector call verify_chain(root, links, leaf_proof, resolver, policy, checker, now, expected_audience=..., expected_request_digest=...) using the vector's expected_audience and expected_request_digest where checker.is_revoked(context) returns true when the root binding or any link binding in context is listed in revoked_bindings, and raises RevocationSourceUnreachable when revocation_unreachable is true. expect_valid and reason (substring) are the required outcome. Link signed bytes are signing_input('chain-link', 1, body); possession proofs use the 'possession' tag over {audience, binding, iat, request_digest}. Link binding = base64url(sha256(signed bytes)).
